look_here_first: Look at the entire flowering scape: ONE tier of three involucral bracts sits BELOW the midpoint. Examine multiple basal leaves: at least one is divided similarly to the involucral bracts. Confirm the bract tier and leaf relationship before using the flower.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Low spring-flowering herbaceous perennial from a short tuber-like rhizome; solitary flower on a scape.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Basal leaves deeply divided; at least one basal leaf resembles the involucral bracts in division.

key_traits.label: Involucre
key_traits.text: One tier of leaflike bracts BELOW midpoint of flowering scape; inspect whole scape for accurate position.

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: One terminal flower with numerous narrow petaloid sepals; color varies and is not a safe separator.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Aggregate achene head; obtain a mature close-up when possible for confirmation.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: one involucral-bract tier BELOW scape midpoint

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: at least one basal leaf divided similarly to bracts

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: solitary spring flower with petaloid sepals

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: often found in sandy habitats, but habitat is supporting only
